ns2:course.label: Leadership and Ethics
ns2:course.description: Provides the student with an understanding of how personal value systems and external ethical requirements affect their leadership styles. Examines Navy organization, personnel administration procedures, human resource management programs, and military justice in terms of current management theory. Prerequisite: NS 303 for NROTC students only; No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: NS 303 for NROTC students only; No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
